suggestions: I'm grateful for a production deploy on a Friday that actually went smoothly, no rollback, no heart attack.
I'm thankful for the imam keeping the Fajr khutbah short on a morning I almost didn't make it out of bed for.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that saved me from shipping an off-by-one bug straight to prod.
I'm thankful for my dad still calling just to ask if I've eaten, even though I'm clearly an adult now.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a client payment that cleared before rent was due, down to the day.
I'm thankful for a stranger holding the LRT door open for two extra seconds when I was sprinting for it.
I'm grateful for the smell of my neighbour frying ikan bilis at 7am, even if it means my room smells like it too.
I'm thankful for a flaky test that finally stopped being flaky after I actually bothered to read the stack trace.
I'm grateful for the quiet ten minutes after subuh before anyone else in the house is awake.
I'm thankful for a senior engineer who explained the legacy codebase instead of just telling me to "read the code".
I'm grateful for cheap nasi lemak bungkus that somehow still tastes better than anything from a fancy cafe.
I'm thankful for my laptop surviving one more year without needing a replacement I can't really afford yet.
I'm grateful for a group chat full of old university friends who still remember my birthday without a reminder.
I'm thankful for the AC in the office actually working today, not stuck on either freezing or broken.
I'm grateful for a Saturday morning with no alarms, just the ceiling fan and the sound of the street waking up.
